## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): one input/metadata contract reconciles
    planned slots, first subjects, all attempts and historical
    selection; distinct six classes/veto/availability/raw/canonical/
    joint populations; D1 golden bounds == [-.4,.5]; whole unrun tasks
    retain weights; explicit B-minus-A new target preserves legacy
    A-minus-B.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): duplicate/missing subjects/keys, incomplete
    required universe, short cells or pending grade cannot yield full
    estimate; unknown is not clean; unbounded/censored metrics get no
    invented finite bounds or latest-history leakage.

    numbered checks + evidence in coverage register; achieved D/E
    recorded separately from owed R/P (R5.49, R5.43).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression; fmt +
    owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode when touched;
    commands + counts; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): records agree; REQ stamps; DEFERRALS;
    ADRs; clauses.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-eval/src/population.rs` (new, pure records-in/out —
   the "eval math" owner of the S.1 shared population/metadata contract):
   `SlotSubject`/`PlannedSlot`/`PopulationInput`/`PlannedPopulation` —
   `assemble` reconciles planned slots (required universe), first
   subjects (primary; first admissible completed retry = flagged
   secondary recovery, retries never raise n), all attempts, and the
   pinned-watermark read (HistoryLeak/WatermarkMissing); populations
   raw / canonical / joint_task_pass_without_observed_veto with
   six-class + veto + availability counts; `contrast_bounds` =
   [s/M,(s+u)/M] per (task,arm) + equal-task Δ=test−control with
   outward ppm rounding, unrun tasks retaining w_t=1/T; `BoundsDecl`
   admits `Unit` only (unbounded/censored → typed refusals);
   `MethodMetadata` (S.1 spine members verbatim) + `PopulationError`
   closed refusal set.
2. `crates/hh-analysis/src/population.rs` (new, ~150 lines) —
   `planned_population(view, runs, metric, pins)` adapter: ExperimentView
   plans+attempts+launch_binding × EvalRun outcomes/success/disposition
   → the eval records; `AnalysisError::Population` wraps the typed
   refusal (one vocabulary).
3. `lib.rs` mod/docs lines (eval + analysis).
4. Batteries: `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_15.rs` (pure contract),
   `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_15.rs` (adapter reconcile).
5. ADR-0394 landing record + regenerated ADR index; run ledger gap
   table/evidence; PR record; close.

## Test matrix

| AC | Planned check |
|---|---|
| AC-1 reconcile | first-subject primary + first-admissible-retry recovery flagged; all attempts retained; M counts slots not attempts |
| AC-1 populations | vetoed pass → raw s / canonical u+vetoed_passes / joint f; six-class + availability counts; missing-checks → joint u |
| AC-1 golden | D1: per-task A={5s,45u}, B={25s,25f}, M=50 → test_minus_control(A,B) = [−400000, 500000] ppm |
| AC-1 unrun | whole unrun task contributes full-width cell → [−w,+w] contrast weight retained |
| AC-1 B−A | test_minus_control(B,A) = [−500000, +400000] explicit new target; legacy compare a−b untouched (existing acceptance battery green) |
| AC-2 dups/keys | duplicate subject across plans; empty subject_run/task/arm; conflicting attempt_no → typed refusals |
| AC-2 universe | required member absent → IncompleteUniverse |
| AC-2 short | short cells keep planned/not-run rows; unresolved → u; complete=false |
| AC-2 pending | pending availability → u + pending_slots; full=false |
| AC-2 unknown | outcome None / missing required checks → u, never clean |
| AC-2 bounds | Unbounded / RightCensored / non-unit Bounded → typed refusals; no invented finite bound |
| AC-2 leakage | seq>pin → HistoryLeak; resolved subject without pin → WatermarkMissing |
| adapter | ExperimentView+EvalRuns reconcile; pending disposition → u |
